_comment: Trap effects database — defines all random outcomes when a player steps on a trap tile. Core fields: weight/type/min/max/amount/zones/message. Optional spice fields: trigger_style, archetype, lingering_turns, lingering_wet, lingering_tum, lingering_delay, narrative_chunk, struggle_threshold, wait_threshold. Loaded at startup by _gen_load_trap_registry().
_zone_keys: any, bsp, forest, nursery, school, hospital, mansion, desert, town, safe_room, littlebig_city

spike_damage.name: Spike Trap
spike_damage.message: A trap springs! You lose {value} HP!

healing_rune.name: Healing Rune
healing_rune.message: A rune glows warmly! You recover {value} HP.

bladder_trap.name: Bladder Trap
bladder_trap.message: All of a sudden your bladder feels more full. Wet +{value}.

gas_trap.name: Gas Trap
gas_trap.message: A strange gas wafts out... your tummy gurgles. Tum +{value}.

str_drain.name: Strength Drain
str_drain.message: A feeble trap drains your strength! STR -{value}.

tickle_rune.name: Tickle Rune
tickle_rune.message: A glowing rune pulses under your feet — a warm, tingly wave rushes through your body! Excitement +{value}.

enchanted_vibration.name: Enchanted Vibration Trap
enchanted_vibration.message: The floor hums with magical energy — your whole body buzzes and your cheeks flush bright red! Excitement +{value}.

dud.name: Dud Trap
dud.message: Click. The trap fizzles out. Nothing happens.

bsp_poison_dart.name: Poison Dart
bsp_poison_dart.message: A dart shoots from the wall and grazes you! You lose {value} HP!

bsp_pit_spikes.name: Spike Pit
bsp_pit_spikes.message: The floor gives way and you tumble into a shallow spike pit! You lose {value} HP!

bsp_healing_spring.name: Hidden Spring
bsp_healing_spring.message: A hidden spring bubbles up through the flagstones. Its warm water restores {value} HP!

bsp_pressure_splash.name: Pressure Plate Splash
bsp_pressure_splash.message: You step on a pressure plate and cold water sprays from the ceiling! Wet +{value}.

bsp_sewer_vent.name: Sewer Gas Vent
bsp_sewer_vent.message: A vent in the floor belches foul sewer gas. Your stomach lurches! Tum +{value}.

bsp_dark_enchantment.name: Dark Enchantment
bsp_dark_enchantment.message: Dark runes pulse beneath your feet, sending a warm, forbidden tingle through your body. Excitement +{value}.

bsp_portcullis.name: Crumbling Portcullis
bsp_portcullis.message: A rusty portcullis drops from the ceiling and clips you! You lose {value} HP!

bsp_moss_cushion.name: Moss Cushion
bsp_moss_cushion.message: You trip into a patch of thick, spongy moss. It's oddly comfortable and you feel a little better. +{value} HP.

bsp_stale_draft.name: Stale Draft Curse
bsp_stale_draft.message: An ancient curse seeps from the stones, sapping your vigor. STR -{value}.

bsp_ancient_dud.name: Rusted Mechanism
bsp_ancient_dud.message: An ancient mechanism clicks beneath your foot... but nothing happens. The trap has long since rusted out.

forest_thorn_snare.name: Thorn Snare
forest_thorn_snare.message: Thorny vines lash out from the undergrowth and scratch you! You lose {value} HP!

forest_ghost_whisper.name: Ghost Whisper
forest_ghost_whisper.message: A spectral voice whispers something breathlessly intimate in your ear. Your face burns hot! Excitement +{value}.

forest_mushroom_spore.name: Puffball Spores
forest_mushroom_spore.message: You kick a cluster of puffball mushrooms and inhale a cloud of spores. Your tummy rumbles ominously! Tum +{value}.

forest_fog_chill.name: Fog Chill
forest_fog_chill.message: An icy mist billows up from the forest floor, sending a shiver straight to your bladder! Wet +{value}.

forest_fairy_circle.name: Fairy Circle
forest_fairy_circle.message: You stumble into a fairy circle! Tiny lights swirl around you and your wounds mend. +{value} HP.

forest_spectral_drain.name: Spectral Drain
forest_spectral_drain.message: A ghostly hand reaches through you, leaving you feeling weak and drained. STR -{value}.

forest_cursed_root.name: Cursed Root
forest_cursed_root.message: A gnarled root wraps around your ankle and squeezes hard! You lose {value} HP!

forest_wisp_tickle.name: Will-o'-Wisp Tickle
forest_wisp_tickle.message: A will-o'-wisp darts between your legs, trailing warm sparks. You squirm and gasp! Excitement +{value}.

forest_dew_splash.name: Dew Splash
forest_dew_splash.message: You brush against a huge leaf and it dumps an ice-cold reservoir of morning dew right on your lap! Wet +{value}.

forest_moth_dust.name: Moth Dust Cloud
forest_moth_dust.message: A cloud of glowing moth dust puffs up around you. It's pretty, but harmless.

nursery_formula_spray.name: Formula Spray Nozzle
nursery_formula_spray.message: A hidden nozzle sprays warm formula straight into your mouth before you can react! Your tummy gurgles heavily. Tum +{value}.

nursery_lullaby.name: Lullaby Speaker
nursery_lullaby.message: A concealed speaker plays a soothing lullaby. Your eyelids droop and your muscles go slack... STR -{value}.

nursery_cream_vent.name: Diaper Cream Vent
nursery_cream_vent.message: A panel in the floor puffs a cloud of warm, tingly diaper cream upward. The sensation is... intense! Excitement +{value}.

nursery_spanker.name: Mechanical Spanker
nursery_spanker.message: A padded mechanical arm swings out from the wall and swats your bottom! You lose {value} HP!

nursery_bottle_launch.name: Bottle Launcher
nursery_bottle_launch.message: A pneumatic arm shoves a warm bottle into your mouth and squeezes! You swallow involuntarily. Tum +{value}.

nursery_sprinkler.name: Nursery Sprinkler
nursery_sprinkler.message: The nursery sprinkler system activates directly above you, drenching you in warm water! Wet +{value}.

nursery_medbot_heal.name: Med-Bot Patch-Up
nursery_medbot_heal.message: A small med-bot scurries out, patches your scrapes with colourful plasters, and scurries away. +{value} HP.

nursery_pacifier_gas.name: Pacifier Gas
nursery_pacifier_gas.message: Sweet-smelling gas hisses from a vent. It makes you feel warm, fuzzy, and strangely tingly... Excitement +{value}.

nursery_conveyor_bump.name: Conveyor Bump
nursery_conveyor_bump.message: A hidden conveyor belt activates and slams you into a padded wall! You lose {value} HP!

nursery_reboot_dud.name: System Reboot
nursery_reboot_dud.message: A panel lights up: 'TRAP MODULE REBOOTING — PLEASE STAND BY.' ...Nothing happens.

school_wet_paint.name: Wet Paint Floor
school_wet_paint.message: You slip on freshly painted floor tiles and crash into a puddle of paint thinner! Wet +{value}.

school_mystery_meat.name: Cafeteria Mystery Meat
school_mystery_meat.message: You step on a lunch tray someone left on the floor. Mystery meat splashes into your mouth. Gross! Tum +{value}.

school_dodgeball.name: Dodgeball Cannon
school_dodgeball.message: A dodgeball cannon fires from behind a locker! WHAM! You lose {value} HP!

school_mop_bucket.name: Mop Bucket Spill
school_mop_bucket.message: You kick over a mop bucket and dirty mop water soaks through your clothes! Wet +{value}.

school_detention_aura.name: Detention Aura
school_detention_aura.message: A magical 'DETENTION' stamp appears on your forehead. The shame saps your will to fight. STR -{value}.

school_nurse_bandaid.name: Nurse's Supply Closet
school_nurse_bandaid.message: You stumble into the school nurse's supply closet. A first-aid kit patches you up! +{value} HP.

school_locker_prank.name: Locker Prank
school_locker_prank.message: Your locker pops open and a bunch of embarrassing photos flutter out! Your face turns beet red! Excitement +{value}.

school_gym_rope.name: Gym Rope Trap
school_gym_rope.message: A gym rope snags your ankle and hoists you upside down for a moment! You lose {value} HP!

school_glitter_bomb.name: Glitter Bomb
school_glitter_bomb.message: A glitter bomb explodes from under a desk! You're covered in sparkles and everyone is staring! Excitement +{value}.

school_bell_dud.name: False Bell
school_bell_dud.message: The school bell rings loudly overhead, but nothing else happens. False alarm!

hospital_sedative_mist.name: Sedative Mist
hospital_sedative_mist.message: A fine sedative mist sprays from a ceiling vent. Your limbs feel like they're made of pudding... STR -{value}.

hospital_iv_ambush.name: IV Drip Ambush
hospital_iv_ambush.message: A mechanical arm stabs an IV into your hand and pumps warm fluid into you before you can pull away! Tum +{value}.

hospital_regression_fog.name: Regression Fog
hospital_regression_fog.message: Pink fog billows from under a door. It smells like baby powder and makes your skin tingle EVERYWHERE. Excitement +{value}.

hospital_defib_shock.name: Defibrillator Shock
hospital_defib_shock.message: A defibrillator panel on the wall discharges wildly! ZAP! You lose {value} HP!

hospital_saline_burst.name: Saline Burst
hospital_saline_burst.message: A saline IV bag bursts overhead, drenching you in cold fluid! Your bladder clenches in shock. Wet +{value}.

hospital_nurse_heal.name: Nurse-Bot Serum
hospital_nurse_heal.message: A helpful nurse-bot rushes over and injects you with a healing serum. +{value} HP!

hospital_exam_restrain.name: Exam Table Restraints
hospital_exam_restrain.message: Padded restraints snap around your wrists from an exam table. You're held just long enough for heat to flood your face. Excitement +{value}.

hospital_formula_iv.name: Formula IV Drip
hospital_formula_iv.message: A hidden tube connected to a formula reservoir squirts warm milk into your mouth! Tum +{value}.

hospital_wheelchair.name: Runaway Wheelchair
hospital_wheelchair.message: An automated wheelchair zooms out of nowhere and clips you! You lose {value} HP!

hospital_monitor_dud.name: Broken Monitor
hospital_monitor_dud.message: A heart monitor beeps frantically for a moment, then flatlines. It was unplugged the whole time.

town_puddle_splash.name: Muddy Puddle
town_puddle_splash.message: You step in a muddy puddle and dirty water splashes up your legs! Wet +{value}.

town_stall_collapse.name: Rickety Market Stall
town_stall_collapse.message: A rickety market stall collapses as you pass and bonks you on the head! You lose {value} HP!

town_herb_tonic.name: Herbalist's Tonic Splash
town_herb_tonic.message: You accidentally knock over an herbalist's health tonic and some splashes into your mouth. Tasty! +{value} HP.

town_whoopee_cushion.name: Whoopee Cushion
town_whoopee_cushion.message: You sit on a hidden whoopee cushion. The ENORMOUS sound draws every eye in the square to you! Excitement +{value}.

town_bakery_aroma.name: Bakery Aroma Blast
town_bakery_aroma.message: The bakery vent blasts you with the smell of fresh pastries. Your tummy growls LOUDLY. Tum +{value}.

town_fountain_jet.name: Fountain Sputter
town_fountain_jet.message: A town fountain sputters and shoots a jet of water right at you! Wet +{value}.

town_street_performer.name: Street Performer
town_street_performer.message: A street performer singles you out for their act. They juggle your belongings while the crowd laughs! Excitement +{value}.

town_cobblestone_trip.name: Loose Cobblestone
town_cobblestone_trip.message: You trip on a loose cobblestone and scrape your knee! You lose {value} HP!

town_stray_cat.name: Stray Cat Nuzzle
town_stray_cat.message: A stray cat nuzzles against your leg. The warmth is oddly comforting. +{value} HP.

town_bird_dud.name: Bird Flyover
town_bird_dud.message: A bird flies overhead. You flinch, expecting the worst... but it passes harmlessly.

desert_rust_wire.name: Rusted Tripwire
desert_rust_wire.message: A rusted wire snaps tight across the canyon floor. Stamina -{value}.

desert_dust_pocket.name: Dust Pocket
desert_dust_pocket.message: The ground coughs up a stale dust cloud. Your tummy twists. Tum +{value}.

desert_cactus_splinter.name: Cactus Splinter
desert_cactus_splinter.message: A dry thorny splinter catches you as you pass. You lose {value} HP.

pq_pressure_pad.name: Princess' Pressure Pad
pq_pressure_pad.message: The test pad hisses and squeezes your nerves. Wet +{value}.

detect_check.label: Spot the pressure seam
detect_check.success_text: You notice the beveled edge before your full weight hits it.
detect_check.partial_text: You spot the seam late, but still have a moment to react.

avoid_check.label: Hop clear of the plate
avoid_check.success_text: You spring off the plate before it vents the full pulse.
avoid_check.partial_text: You twist away, but the trap still clips you.

pq_wire_snare.name: Princess' Wire Snare
pq_wire_snare.message: A silver wire snaps up from the floor and steals your footing. Stamina -{value}.

detect_check.label: Read the wire path
detect_check.success_text: You catch the pattern of the wire before it fully rises.

avoid_check.label: Slip past the snare
avoid_check.success_text: Keeping low lets you slide under the nastiest part of the mechanism.
avoid_check.partial_text: You almost clear it, but the wire still yanks something from you.

resist_check.label: Tear free of the snag
resist_check.success_text: You wrench loose before the snare can cinch all the way.

pq_glue_restraint.name: Princess' Restraint Glue
pq_glue_restraint.message: Warm restraint glue splashes up your legs and locks in place. Wet/Tum +{value}.

avoid_check.label: Plant and brace before it spreads
avoid_check.partial_text: You cut the splash down, but you still end up stuck.

resist_check.label: Bear the restraint
resist_check.success_text: You hold your center and keep the trap from turning truly ugly.
resist_check.partial_text: You weather most of it, but not gracefully.

lbc_confetti_cannon.name: Confetti Cannon
lbc_confetti_cannon.message: The pavement plate clicks and the street ERUPTS in confetti! Excitement +{value}.

lbc_applause_plate.name: Applause Plate
lbc_applause_plate.message: A hidden plate triggers recorded applause — and a coin slot pays out. +{value}× civic bonus!

lbc_sample_spigot.name: Sample Spigot
lbc_sample_spigot.message: A pavement spigot fills your flask whether you wanted it or not. Wet +{value}.

lbc_lullaby_speaker.name: Lullaby Speaker
lbc_lullaby_speaker.message: A hidden speaker starts a lullaby and your knees agree with it. Stamina -{value}.

lbc_powder_puff.name: Powder Puff Vent
lbc_powder_puff.message: A vent puffs sweet pastel powder over you. Something loosens. Incontinence +{value}.

lbc_photo_flash.name: Portrait Flash
lbc_photo_flash.message: A tripod camera fires unbidden. The Index board pays for the plate. +{value}× civic bonus!

lbc_bouncy_paving.name: Bouncy Paving
lbc_bouncy_paving.message: A whole paving slab turns out to be a trampoline. Wet/Tum +{value}.

lbc_helpful_bench.name: Helpful Bench
lbc_helpful_bench.message: You sit down without deciding to. It is wonderful. Stamina +{value}.

beats.text: Sharp metal spikes spring up from hidden panels at your feet. You leap back but not fast enough — the tips catch you and draw blood. The sudden shock of pain makes your whole body clench, including muscles you wish hadn't.

A warm glow spreads from the floor beneath your feet. Soft golden runes spiral upward around your body, knitting your wounds closed and easing your aches. It feels like being tucked in — briefly, mercifully safe.

Something clicks beneath the floor and a wave of magical pressure hits your lower abdomen. Your bladder immediately clenches and fills, the urgency hitting you all at once like someone turned a faucet on inside you. You press your thighs together desperately.

A vent hisses open and thick, sweet-smelling gas billows into your face. Almost instantly your stomach starts gurgling and cramping — whatever that gas was, it went straight to your guts. The rumbling is loud enough that anyone nearby would definitely hear it.

A sickly purple light pulses from a cracked rune set into the wall. It doesn't hurt, but you feel your muscles slacken — your arms heavy, your grip weak. The magical fatigue settles over you like a damp, heavy blanket.

A glowing rune pulses beneath your feet and ethereal fingers of light brush across your skin. The sensation is overwhelmingly ticklish — you squirm and gasp as warm waves of involuntary excitement ripple through your body. By the time the rune fades, your composure is in tatters.

The floor beneath you hums with deep magical resonance. The vibration travels up through your legs and into your core, making your whole body flush with heat. Your cheeks burn and your thoughts scatter as the enchantment runs its course — leaving you flustered and very aware of your body.

Click. Whirr. A mechanical arm extends from the wall, rotates once, and retracts with a sad little squeak. Nothing happens. You stare at the spot where the trap was, waiting for the other shoe to drop. Still nothing. You feel oddly cheated.

A dart hisses from a slot in the ancient stonework and catches your arm. The tip burns — not lethally, but enough to make you flinch and stumble. A thin trickle of blood winds down to your wrist as the venom makes your skin tingle.

The flagstones give way and you tumble into a shallow pit lined with rusted spikes. The fall knocks the breath out of you and the spikes tear at your clothes and skin. You claw your way out, battered and shaking.

Warm water bubbles up through cracked flagstones, pooling around your feet in a soft golden glow. The spring water tingles against your skin and your wounds begin to close. It's soothing — almost too soothing for a place like this.

You step on a stone that shifts with a grinding click. Cold water jets from hidden nozzles in the ceiling and drenches you head to toe. The chill goes straight to your core — and straight to your bladder. You squeeze your legs together, gasping.

A rusted grate beneath your feet erupts with a belch of hot sewer gas. The stench hits your stomach like a fist — you double over as your guts cramp and churn. The rumbling doesn't stop even after the air clears.

Dark runes pulse in the grooves between stone tiles, painting your skin in crimson light. A forbidden warmth blooms in your chest and works its way downward. You clutch the wall for support, flushed and desperately unsteady.

A portcullis drops from its housing in a shower of rust and stone chips. The iron grate clips your shoulder on the way down and the impact sends you stumbling sideways. At least it's too rusted to trap you underneath.

You trip over an uneven flagstone and land face-first in a thick patch of luminescent moss. It's absurdly soft — like falling into a warm pillow. The moss's gentle glow seeps through your clothes and a tingle mends your scrapes.

A stale draft rolls through the corridor, carrying something ancient and spiteful with it. The curse is subtle — you barely feel it settle over you — but your arms grow heavy and your step falters. Strength drains away like water.

A mechanism clicks beneath the flagstone, followed by a grinding noise, a sad wheeze, and then silence. Whatever this trap was supposed to do, it stopped working approximately three centuries ago. You almost feel bad for it.

Thorny vines lash from the undergrowth and wrap around your legs before you can react. The barbs tear at your clothes and scratch your skin as you rip yourself free, leaving thin lines of blood on your shins and a stinging awareness of every inch of exposed skin.

A spectral voice materializes at your ear and whispers something intimate — something secret — something that makes your whole body flush with heat. By the time you spin around, there's nothing there. Just your racing heartbeat and burning cheeks.

Your foot catches a cluster of bulbous puffball mushrooms and they explode in a cloud of brown spores. You inhale a lungful before you can cover your face. Your stomach immediately begins to protest — loudly, insistently, embarrassingly.

An unnatural fog rolls in at ankle height, cold enough to make you shiver violently. The chill penetrates straight through your clothes and settles in your lower body. Your bladder clenches hard in response, urgency spiking without warning.

You stumble into a ring of softly glowing mushrooms. Tiny pinpricks of light dance around you in a slow spiral, and your pain melts away as the fairy circle works its gentle magic. For a brief, precious moment, everything feels safe.

A translucent hand reaches through your chest from behind. There's no pain — just a sudden, bone-deep weakness as the ghost feeds on your vitality. Your legs nearly buckle before the specter withdraws and vanishes into the canopy.

A gnarled tree root surges from the soil and wraps around your ankle with shocking force. It squeezes until you cry out, then releases just as suddenly, retreating back underground. The bruise it leaves is deep and throbbing.

A mischievous will-o'-wisp darts into your personal space, trailing sparks of warm light across your body. The sensation is unbearably ticklish — you squirm and gasp, face flushing, unable to swat the tiny thing away until it gets bored and flits off.

You brush past an enormous leaf and it dumps an icy reservoir of morning dew directly onto your lap. The cold soaks through instantly, and the wet sensation running down your legs makes your already-stressed bladder clench painfully.

A cloud of glowing moth dust erupts from the canopy, swirling around you in iridescent patterns. It's beautiful. It's completely harmless. You sneeze once, and the moths scatter into the trees. Nature's dud trap.

A hidden nozzle activates at face height and sprays warm, sweet formula directly into your open mouth before you can react. You swallow involuntarily — twice — and your stomach gurgles loudly as it tries to process the unwanted feeding.

A concealed speaker crackles to life and plays a slow, gentle lullaby. The melody is designed for someone much younger than you — but it works anyway. Your eyelids droop, your muscles slacken, and your guard drops to nothing.

A panel in the floor puffs a cloud of warm, tingly diaper cream powder upward. It settles on your skin and the tingling intensifies — especially below your waist. Your face burns scarlet as your body responds in ways you absolutely cannot control.

A padded mechanical arm swings out from the wall on a spring-loaded hinge. SMACK! It catches you right on the bottom with just enough force to make your eyes water. The arm retracts primly, as if judging you.

A pneumatic arm extends from a wall panel clutching a warm bottle. Before you can dodge, it presses the nipple to your lips and squeezes. Warm, sweet formula floods your mouth and you swallow helplessly. Your tummy protests the volume immediately.

Ceiling-mounted sprinkler heads activate directly above you, showering you in warm water. The nursery's system is designed for soothing fussy occupants — the temperature is perfect, which makes the drenching feel disturbingly nurturing.

A tiny med-bot rolls out from a wall compartment and scans your injuries with a blue light. It applies colorful plasters to each wound, gives you a cheerful beep, and rolls away. You feel better — even if every plaster has cartoon animals on it.

Sweet, candy-scented gas hisses from a vent shaped like a pacifier. You breathe it in before you realize what's happening. Warmth spreads through your body — a fuzzy, tingly sensation that leaves you flushed and embarrassingly lightheaded.

A hidden conveyor belt activates beneath your feet and hurls you sideways into a padded wall. The impact is cushioned — this is a nursery, after all — but the sudden jolt makes your bladder clench. You peel yourself off the pastel-colored padding, wincing.

A panel lights up with friendly text: 'NURSERY DEFENSE MODULE — REBOOTING — PLEASE STAND BY.' You tense, ready for anything. The panel flickers, displays 'REBOOT FAILED — SORRY! ^_^', and goes dark. You exhale.

You slip on a freshly painted section of hallway floor and crash hip-first into a puddle of paint thinner. The cold liquid soaks through your clothes instantly. The wet sensation against your skin makes your bladder twitch nervously as you scramble back up.

You step on an abandoned lunch tray and a glob of cafeteria mystery meat splats upward into your mouth. The taste is indescribable — and your stomach's reaction is immediate. Gurgling, cramping, and an ominous rumble that does not stop.

A spring-loaded cannon hidden behind a row of lockers fires a dodgeball directly at your face. WHAM! It bounces off with a rubbery thwack that leaves your ears ringing and your nose stinging. At least nobody saw. Probably.

Your foot catches the handle of a mop bucket and sends it spinning. Dirty gray mop water cascades across the floor and soaks through your shoes, your socks, and up your legs. The cold, soapy wetness creeps upward, making everything terribly uncomfortable.

A magical stamp materializes on your forehead reading 'DETENTION.' The enchantment drains your will to fight — your shoulders slump, your fists unclench, and you feel like you've been scolded by every authority figure you've ever known, simultaneously.

You stumble through a door marked 'NURSE' and find a first-aid kit sitting open on the desk. You help yourself to bandages and antiseptic. The school nurse's office smells like latex and grape-flavored medicine, but the treatment works.

Your locker pops open and a cascade of embarrassing photos flutter out — every one of them shows you in some compromising moment you don't even remember being photographed in. Nearby students are already looking. Your face turns absolutely scarlet.

A gym rope drops from the ceiling, loops around your ankle, and hoists you upside down for several terrifying seconds. Blood rushes to your head and the rope burns your skin before the mechanism releases and dumps you unceremoniously on the mat.

A small package under a desk explodes in a shower of sparkly glitter. It gets in your hair, your clothes, your eyebrows — everything. Every person in the vicinity is now staring at the disco ball that used to be a person. You will be sparkling for days.

The school bell rings with an ear-splitting CLANG directly above your head. You flinch, cover your ears, and brace for something terrible — but it was just the bell. Class is over, apparently. Nothing happens.

A fine mist sprays from a ceiling vent as you pass beneath it. The sedative hits your bloodstream through your lungs — your muscles go limp, your thoughts slow to a crawl, and your limbs feel like they're wrapped in warm, heavy cotton.

A mechanical arm shoots out from the wall, stabs an IV needle into your hand, and begins pumping warm fluid before you can react. Your stomach fills rapidly with whatever the bag contains. By the time you rip the needle out, the damage to your tummy is done.

Pink fog billows from beneath a door marked 'REGRESSION THERAPY.' It smells like baby powder and vanilla, and it makes every inch of your exposed skin tingle. Your body responds with overwhelming, involuntary warmth that rushes to your cheeks and everywhere else.

An automated defibrillator mounted on the corridor wall goes haywire. CLEAR! The paddles discharge with a blinding arc and the electrical shock knocks you sideways. Your muscles spasm for several seconds after — including ones controlling things you'd rather stayed shut.

An IV bag mounted on the wall ruptures and douses you in cold saline solution. The sterile fluid soaks through your clothes and runs down your legs. The cold shock goes straight to your bladder — you squeeze your thighs together desperately.

A helpful nurse-bot glides over on silent wheels, scans your injuries with a green light, and administers a healing serum via a surprisingly gentle injection. Your wounds close and pain fades. The bot gives you a little bow before rolling away.

You brush against an exam table and padded restraints snap around your wrists with a magnetic click. You're held in place for just a few seconds — but the helplessness, the vulnerability, the clinical exposure sends heat rushing to your face before they release.

A concealed tube connected to a formula reservoir drops from the ceiling and squirts warm, thick formula into your mouth. You swallow reflexively before you can spit it out. Your stomach immediately begins to swell with the forced feeding.

An automated wheelchair rockets down the corridor at full speed and clips your hip hard. You spin and hit the floor while the wheelchair continues on its way, bumping off a wall and disappearing around a corner without a care.

A heart monitor on the wall starts beeping frantically — fast, then faster, building to an alarming crescendo. Then it flatlines with a long, sad tone. A label on the side reads: 'UNPLUGGED — DO NOT USE.' Nothing happens.

Your foot finds a deceptively deep puddle in the cobblestones. Muddy water splashes up your legs and soaks through your clothing. Several passersby glance your way, which somehow makes the cold wetness seeping upward feel even worse.

A market stall you brush past decides this is the moment to give up on structural integrity. Planks, poles, and someone's collection of decorative gourds crash down around you. You emerge bruised, covered in splinters, and very embarrassed.

You accidentally elbow a rack of the herbalist's health tonics. One bottle tumbles, shatters, and splashes directly into your open mouth. It tastes like mint and regret — but your wounds tingle and begin to mend as the potion takes effect.

You sit down on what seemed like a perfectly normal bench. PFBBBBT! The whoopee cushion unleashes an enormous, obscene noise that echoes across the entire town square. Every single head turns. Your face achieves a shade of red previously unknown to science.

The bakery vent opens directly in your face, blasting you with the concentrated aroma of fresh bread, pastries, and cream-filled tarts. Your stomach roars to life — a deep, demanding growl that multiple nearby shoppers definitely, unmistakably hear.

The town fountain chooses this exact moment to malfunction. A jet of cold water arcs from the spout and catches you directly in the midsection, soaking through your clothes. A small child across the square points at you and giggles.

A street performer singles you out of the crowd and pulls you into their act. They juggle your belongings while the gathered audience watches and laughs. The attention is overwhelming, and the performer's running commentary about your outfit is mortifying.

A loose cobblestone catches your toe and you pitch forward, catching yourself on your palms. The scrape burns your hands and your knee hits the stone hard enough to make you see stars. A couple of onlookers wince in sympathy.

A stray tabby cat trots over and butts its head against your shin, purring like a tiny motor. The warmth spreads from the contact point through your whole body. Your scrapes sting a little less. You feel a little less alone in this strange place.

A large bird swoops overhead. You throw your arms up, bracing for impact — or worse. The bird continues on its way without incident. You lower your arms slowly, very aware that several townsfolk just watched you flinch at a pigeon.
A taut wire snaps up from the floor and bites into your stride before you can recover. You catch yourself, but only barely — your legs feel unsteady and drained.
Pressure hisses under your feet and a sticky burst splashes up your legs and waist. The glue hardens almost instantly — you're stuck in place, legs cemented to the floor.
You strain and pull, managing to loosen the grip slightly. The glue stretches but holds. Your muscles burn from the effort, but you refuse to give in.
You stand there, feeling the glue slowly soften against your body heat. It's humiliating being rooted in place like this — helpless, exposed, unable to do anything but wait.
With a final desperate wrench, you tear yourself free! Strips of glue still cling to your clothes, but you're moving again. Your determination kept your dignity mostly intact.

The glue finally dissolves enough for you to pull free. You've been standing here for what felt like an eternity — helpless, exposed, and increasingly aware of the pressure building in your bladder while you couldn't reach a bathroom.

Your foot comes down on a brass plate and the whole street goes off at once — six cannons, a shower of paper, and a brass fanfare from a speaker you cannot locate.

Everybody stops to look. Everybody *cheers*. A woman with a pram gives you a thumbs up.

You have done nothing. You stepped on a plate. Your heart is going like a bird's.

Recorded applause swells out of the lamp posts, warm and enormous and entirely automatic.

A little brass slot in the nearest kiosk clunks, and counts, and pays.

It is paying you for *being seen*. The more of a spectacle you already were when you stepped on the plate, the longer the counting goes on.

A spigot pops out of the kerb at ankle height and fills the nearest vessel, which — because this city hands you things — is the enormous complimentary cup you are already holding.

It is cold and it is lemon and something green and it is *delicious*, and you have drunk most of it before the reflex catches up with your judgement.

Hydration is civic. The cart said so.

Something in the awning above you begins, very softly, to sing.

It is not loud. It is not even especially good. But it is pitched exactly at the frequency of every nap you have ever been talked into, and your shoulders come down, and your pace drops, and you find yourself looking at a bench you had not previously noticed.

The song is four minutes long. It loops.

A grille in the pavement exhales a cloud of pastel powder that smells of talc and vanilla and settles on you like a compliment.

A passing man beams. "Ooh, you got the good corner!"

Whatever is in it is not talc. Something low down in you goes quietly, permanently, a little further off-duty, and the street smells absolutely wonderful.

A camera on a tripod that nobody is standing behind swivels, focuses, and fires.

The flash powder goes up with a polite bang. Somewhere a plate drops into a hopper for collection, captioned automatically, bound for the big board.

A brass slot pays you the sitting fee. It pays *well*. The board likes candour, and it has just taken a very candid photograph of you.

The slab gives. Not a crack — a *bounce*, deep and springy and clearly deliberate, and then the two either side of it join in.

You are airborne twice before you get your feet under you, and three children materialise from nowhere to bounce alongside you, delighted, shrieking.

Your insides do not appreciate the acrobatics. They keep not appreciating it for a while.

There is a bench exactly where you needed one, at exactly the height you needed, and you are sitting on it before the thought *should I sit down* has finished forming.

It is glorious. Your legs sing. Somebody drifts past and tucks a folded blanket onto the seat beside you without breaking stride or making eye contact.

You get up feeling genuinely restored, which is the part to be frightened of.
